influences.name: Remedios Varo

influences.name: Tamara de Lempicka
influences.context: A collector of Tamara de Lempicka's Art Deco paintings, Madonna has featured them throughout her music videos and stage productions.

influences.name: Guy Bourdin
influences.context: Her video for "Hollywood" (2003) paid tribute to the photography of Guy Bourdin, though it later prompted a lawsuit filed by Bourdin's son over the unauthorized use of his father's images.

influences.name: Andy Warhol
influences.context: The sadomasochistic motifs in pop artist Andy Warhol's underground films were echoed in the videos for "Erotica" and "Deeper and Deeper".

influences.name: Christopher Flynn
influences.context: Her ballet teacher, Christopher Flynn, inspired her to pursue a career in dance.

influences.name: William Orbit
influences.context: She collaborated with electronic music producer William Orbit to create a fusion of dance, pop, and British rock.

influences.name: Sandra Bernhard
influences.context: After the birth of Lourdes, Madonna developed an interest in Eastern mysticism and Kabbalah, introduced to her by actress Sandra Bernhard.
